questions.question: Which mountain system extends along much of western North America's interior?
choices: Appalachian Mountains
Andes Mountains
Rocky Mountains
Alps

questions.question: Which mountain system lies in eastern North America?
choices: Appalachian Mountains
Rocky Mountains
Sierra Madre Occidental
Cascade Range

questions.question: Which broad grassland region lies east of the Rocky Mountains?
choices: Canadian Shield
Great Plains
Yucatán Peninsula
Florida Everglades

questions.question: Which country occupies much of the northern North American mainland?
choices: Mexico
Guatemala
Cuba
Canada

questions.question: Which country shares the United States' southern land border?
choices: Mexico
Belize
Honduras
Panama

questions.question: Which river system drains a large part of the central United States?
choices: Amazon system
Danube system
Mississippi-Missouri system
Nile system

questions.question: Which two countries share the Great Lakes region?
choices: United States and Mexico
United States and Canada
Canada and Greenland
Mexico and Guatemala

questions.question: Why do North American climates vary widely?
choices: Every part lies at the same latitude
Ocean conditions are identical on both coasts
Mountains have no influence on regional climates
The continent spans large latitude ranges and varied elevations and coastlines

questions.question: How do the Great Plains support major farming regions?
choices: Broad plains and suitable soils support extensive agriculture where water is available
The region has the same rainfall everywhere
Every part supports only tropical plantation crops
Its terrain prevents the use of farm machinery

questions.question: Why are waterways such as the Great Lakes and St. Lawrence important?
choices: They connect directly to the Pacific without canals or land routes
They form a single ocean saltwater basin
They support transport and connect inland areas with Atlantic routes
They eliminate the need for ports

questions.question: How does the Canadian Shield influence land use?
choices: Deep tropical soils favor plantation farming across the entire region
Young volcanic rock and an arid climate limit forestry across the region
Thin soils limit farming; exposed rock supports some resource industries
Extensive river-delta soils make irrigated cotton its principal land use

questions.question: Why are many western areas comparatively dry?
choices: The entire west lies beyond the reach of sunlight
All western land has identical elevation
The Pacific contains no water vapor
Mountain barriers and atmospheric patterns limit moisture in some interior regions

questions.question: Why is North America broader than the United States and Canada alone?
choices: Geographic definitions also include Mexico, Central America, the Caribbean, and Greenland
Mexico lies entirely in South America
The Caribbean is geographically part of Europe
Central America is a separate continent in the seven-continent model

questions.question: How have migration and Indigenous histories shaped the continent?
choices: They created one identical culture across all regions
They prevented cities from developing
They contributed to diverse languages, cultures, and settlement patterns
They removed all regional differences in land use

questions.question: Why is freshwater management a regional concern?
choices: Freshwater is equally abundant in every region
Demand, drought, pollution, and shared waters can create competing needs
Water use never crosses political boundaries
All rivers carry the same flow year-round

questions.question: A farmer in a dry western basin relies on irrigation. What geographic relationship is illustrated?
choices: The absence of any climate influence on agriculture
Uniform rainfall across the continent
A requirement that all farming occur on coasts
Human adaptation to limited local water supplies

questions.question: Which comparison of the Rockies and Appalachians is accurate?
choices: They are distinct western and eastern mountain systems
Both lie entirely in Mexico
Both are branches of the Andes
Both occupy the same location along the Atlantic coast

questions.question: A study examines freight traveling from inland Great Lakes ports to the Atlantic. Which system is central?
choices: Panama's mountain plateau
Amazon drainage basin
Great Lakes–St. Lawrence waterway
Bering land bridge

questions.question: Which evidence best explains uneven population distribution?
choices: Only the total number of national flags
Maps of settlement compared with climate, resources, transport, and economic activity
Only the names of mountain peaks
Only the dates of international sporting events

questions.question: Why should a regional map distinguish cultural regions from political borders?
choices: Every national boundary separates completely uniform cultures
Political borders determine every local climate
Cultural regions always have legally fixed boundaries
Cultural patterns may cross borders and vary within countries
